headline: Samsung profit jumps 783% to $80 billion: AI chip boom boosts TSMC
summary: Samsung Electronics estimated third-quarter operating profit of about 107.4 trillion won ($80.2 billion), roughly ninefold higher. Taiwan's TSMC posted record sales on the AI chip boom.
why: Samsung is a global memory chip and smartphone maker, and TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, so both are bellwethers for the AI hardware cycle.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: The company estimated a roughly ninefold rise in third-quarter operating profit.
